package com.follower; /** * Standard unarmed player pose animations. * *

Real players take their pose set from the equipped weapon's definition, which * the RuneLite API doesn't expose. These unarmed defaults look right for most * outfits; override them in the config if you want weapon-appropriate stances. */ class PlayerPose { static final int IDLE = 808, WALK = 819, TURN_180 = 820, SIDESTEP_LEFT = 821, SIDESTEP_RIGHT = 822, IDLE_TURN = 823; }
